items.text: Child nutrition waivers are crucial to making sure that all of our kids have access to a meal every day. Glad to see this bipartisan bill pass! @POTUS should sign it ASAP—this is about the health and wellbeing of our children.

TUNE IN: My congressional colleagues and I are joined by @ParisHilton and other survivors of abuse in residential treatment facilities for the introduction of the Stop Institutional Child Abuse Act. https://t.co/h6vbU8pFIQ

Without oversight, residential treatment too often becomes residential abuse. @JohnCornyn and I introduced the bipartisan Stop Institutional Child Abuse Act to provide oversight for institutional youth programs nationwide. We must reform this broken system!https://t.co/oaUEm5ZM6R

Outdated laws should not arbitrarily preclude @DeptVetAffairs doctors from prescribing the treatment that’s best for veterans. Our servicemembers have given too much to be met with roadblocks to the care they need. https://t.co/JRAWnF9oxW

Water is the elixir of life, but for too long, the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs has faced obstacles to accessing reliable drinking water. I have made it my priority as Chair of Interior Appropriations to change that. https://t.co/KJSKRjPaXw

Today, @RonWyden and I joined leaders from the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs, @EPAnorthwest, @IHSgov, and other federal partners to celebrate a combined $28 million federal investment to build a new water treatment facility that will better serve the community. https://t.co/ZrS5yNplHQ

For far too long the Warm Springs community has needed modern water infrastructure to reliably serve folks with clean, safe water. Federal investments mean relief is coming after years of dealing with a dangerously outdated system.
https://t.co/XxymJ89gm6

Nurses are essential to keeping our communities safer and healthier—and they deserve fair pay and benefits for the lifesaving work they do. Solidarity with @OregonNurses demanding fair treatment. Providence: Nurses are ready to bargain—come back to the table ASAP!

We have to be better than this. Everyone seeking asylum deserves—at the very least—humane treatment. We need to greet those seeking asylum with compassion and protection instead of brutality.

That is the kind of policy I’m pursuing, including with my Children’s Safe Welcome Act.

TUNE IN: @RepBowman and I are introducing a bill to ban legacy admissions—the children of alumni and donors shouldn’t get preferential treatment in the college admissions process. https://t.co/s1FseFKtTf

Children of alumni and donors shouldn’t get preferential treatment in the admissions process—that’s why @RepBowman and I introduced the Fair College Admissions for Students Act. https://t.co/CMusE2ym2H

An especially big issue is the shortage of behavioral health care workers. We are working to grow federal investments that boost the recruitment and training of counselors, addiction treatment professionals, and other skilled mental health care workers in every corner of Oregon.

It’s going to take all of us to tackle this issue from all sides, united in curbing the drug pipeline, education and prevention, and increased addiction treatment - to push back against fentanyl and opioid abuse to save children’s lives here in Oregon and across the county.

Pretty unbelievable: Republicans are willing to sink their own budget deal (from just three months ago) and tank our economy all to push their unpopular, dangerous agenda and cut programs that help many Americans, from disability benefits to nutrition assistance for kids.

It’s Breast Cancer Awareness Month—a reminder of the millions of people impacted by breast cancer every year. Screening is a crucial tool for early detection and treatment. I encourage folks to get screened this month. https://t.co/rmhybLTtFa

Plastic pollution isn’t just a huge environmental problem—plastics are impacting the health of people across our country and around the globe. We need to pass my Break Free from Plastic Pollution Act as a serious step forward.
https://t.co/QHZNqdowWK

GREAT step. Our reliance on dirty energy is fueling climate chaos, threatening our health, and destroying our environment.

The Biden admin is right to weigh if CP2 is in the public interest. (Hint: it’s not).

Every decision should get the same treatment!
https://t.co/E2u1jonVEe

I strongly condemn Putin’s sham presidential election in Russia. Elections must be held to hear the will of the people, not as an exercise in propping up and perpetuating a corrupt dictator and his illegitimate regime. https://t.co/uHnjT7HHe1

PFAS are called “forever chemicals” because the harm they cause is lasting.

The Biden administration is taking critical, bold action to ensure communities have safe, clean water.

I’ll continue to fight in the Senate to tackle the serious threat of PFAS.
https://t.co/albRChonXv
Solidarity with @ufcw555 workers at Fred Meyers who are striking against unfair labor practices! Everyone deserves fair treatment and pay at work.

Breast cancer affects millions of people each year—it’s the second leading cause of cancer deaths for women in the U.S.

Screening is a crucial tool for early detection and treatment. During #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth, I encourage folks to get screened.
https://t.co/3DbAQR6IB4

The Senate just UNANIMOUSLY passed our Stop Institutional Child Abuse Act! Without oversight, residential treatment for troubled teens can become residential abuse. This bill is a path toward fixing the broken system—we need to get it passed in the House and to @POTUS’s desk!

I created the WIFIA program in 2014 to help solve our water infrastructure challenges. 
 
Today, we celebrate a huge WIFIA investment in the Bull Run Treatment Program—which brings safer drinking water to Portland-area folks and creates thousands of construction jobs. Win-win! https://t.co/EYDxu4VZZ7

Trump’s treatment of Zelenskyy today was disgusting and damaging. We should be standing up for Ukraine’s democracy.  

For Putin, Trump is the gift that keeps on giving. https://t.co/05mhWgnddX

NEW: I’m teaming up with @RepMaxineWaters to rein in Trump’s reckless firings of federal employees. Check out the RIF Review Act. Congress needs to exercise its oversight of the executive branch.https://t.co/GaU9bX9qbj
